borrowed_principal.title: Recorded loan principal
borrowed_principal.definition: Principal recorded on the loans counted for this date, before subtracting repayments.
borrowed_principal.meaning: Repayments do not reduce this borrowing total. Open the active-loan breakdown for remaining balances.

debt_settlement.title: Loan settlement
debt_settlement.definition: The modeled amount needed to settle the listed loan obligations, including the charges shown in the breakdown.
debt_settlement.meaning: This can include principal, accrued interest and projected tax loans; it is broader than principal alone.

sales_cash.title: Cash from recorded sales
sales_cash.definition: Net proceeds from recorded sales through the selected date, after the modeled deductions.
sales_cash.meaning: This is historical sale cash, separate from the estimate for selling the shares still held.

stock_value.title: Stock valuation
stock_value.definition: The value of vested shares at the applicable share price, plus purchased unvested shares at their cost where indicated.
stock_value.meaning: Loans and estimated exit tax still need to be considered before treating this as spendable cash.

interest.title: Loan interest
interest.definition: The charge for borrowing money, shown here through the selected date.
interest.meaning: Check the breakdown to distinguish charges already recorded from projected borrowing costs.

timeline.title: Timeline event
timeline.definition: A dated change such as vesting, a loan coming due or a planned sale.
timeline.meaning: A planned event is not proof that a payment or sale has been recorded.

portfolio.title: Retirement portfolio
portfolio.definition: The assets included in this retirement simulation, across the account types you entered.
portfolio.meaning: Account access rules and taxes affect when those assets can fund spending.

gross_proceeds.title: Gross sale proceeds
gross_proceeds.definition: The sale value before estimated taxes and any loan repayment.
gross_proceeds.meaning: This is not the amount you can spend after settling obligations.

net_proceeds.title: Net sale proceeds
net_proceeds.definition: The modeled cash from this sale after the listed deductions.
net_proceeds.meaning: Review the sale breakdown for estimated tax and any associated loan repayment.

vesting.title: Vested and unvested shares
vesting.definition: Vested shares have been earned under the grant schedule. Unvested shares still depend on future vesting.
vesting.meaning: Leaving can change what you keep; check your grant agreement.

grant.title: Purchase and bonus grants
grant.definition: A purchase grant has a price you pay, often with a loan. A free or bonus grant starts without a purchase price.
grant.meaning: The agreement and any 83(b) election determine the tax treatment.

basis.title: Cost basis
basis.definition: The amount used to calculate a taxable gain when shares are sold, including purchase cost or value already taxed as income.
basis.meaning: It is not today's share value. A higher basis usually leaves less gain to tax on the same sale.

loan.title: Loan principal
loan.definition: The outstanding borrowed amount, separate from borrowing charges.
loan.meaning: Interest and projected tax loans can be owed in addition to this principal.

tax.title: Estimated taxes
tax.definition: An estimate using your saved tax rates and records.
tax.meaning: Withholding, tax loans and the final tax return can differ. This is not a tax bill.

exit.title: Cash if you leave
exit.definition: The estimated cash from selling the shares you can retain and settling the modeled exit obligations.
exit.meaning: Share value alone is not take-home cash. Earlier sale proceeds are shown separately.

price.title: Tentative share price
price.definition: A price estimate that has not been confirmed as an announcement.
price.meaning: An effective date makes it apply to calculations; it does not confirm that Epic announced it.

fmv.title: Fair market value (FMV)
fmv.definition: The share value used for a particular date.
fmv.meaning: This values shares before subtracting loan obligations and estimated exit taxes.

tranche.title: Tranche
tranche.definition: One group of shares within a grant or vesting schedule.
tranche.meaning: Different groups can have different purchase prices, vesting dates and tax treatment.

capital_gains.title: Capital gains
capital_gains.definition: The increase from the tax basis of shares to their sale value.
capital_gains.meaning: Short-term and long-term gains can face different rates; the app tracks holding dates and selected lots.

short_term.title: Short-term gains
short_term.definition: Gains on shares that have not met the long-term holding requirement.
short_term.meaning: These usually use ordinary-income rates; the holding-period setting affects the app's estimate.

long_term.title: Long-term gains
long_term.definition: Gains on shares held beyond the applicable long-term holding requirement.
long_term.meaning: These can use different rates from salary and short-term gains.

accrued_interest.title: Accrued or unbooked interest
accrued_interest.definition: Borrowing charges that have built up but are not yet recorded as another loan.
accrued_interest.meaning: This is a calculated estimate unless reconciled to a statement. It can add to what you owe on exit.

capitalised_interest.title: Capitalised interest
capitalised_interest.definition: Unpaid borrowing charges added to a loan balance or recorded as an interest loan.
capitalised_interest.meaning: It is still debt, even though it began as an interest charge. A statement can replace the app's projection.

divest_tax.title: Exit or divestment tax
divest_tax.definition: Estimated tax from selling shares as part of leaving.
divest_tax.meaning: The estimate is part of the exit calculation; it is not another amount to subtract from the final exit cash.

liquidation.title: Liquidation
liquidation.definition: Selling shares to turn them into cash.
liquidation.meaning: The sale price, tax basis, loan settlement and taxes determine how much cash remains.

election_83b.title: 83(b) election
election_83b.definition: A tax election that can move the income-tax event for restricted shares from vesting to the grant date.
election_83b.meaning: Timing matters. Epic purchases and free grants have different rules; use the signed agreement and your tax adviser.

form_4952.title: Investment interest deduction / Form 4952
form_4952.definition: An itemized deduction that can apply investment-interest expense against eligible net investment income.
form_4952.meaning: It is not automatic. Eligibility, gain treatment, year selection and your own return determine the actual saving.

lot_selection.title: Tax lots and FIFO/LIFO
lot_selection.definition: A tax lot is a group bought or taxed at the same basis. FIFO sells oldest lots first; LIFO starts with newest lots.
lot_selection.meaning: Choosing lots can change taxable gains, holding periods and which shares remain. The default is a calculation method, not personalized tax advice.

percentiles.title: Percentiles
percentiles.definition: A way to describe a range of simulated outcomes: the 10th percentile has 10% of outcomes below it.
percentiles.meaning: The median is the middle outcome, not a promise. The bad-case range matters alongside the headline probability.

funding_shortfall.title: Funding shortfall
funding_shortfall.definition: A simulation could not pay a required expense or tax at the time it was due.
funding_shortfall.meaning: A shortfall can happen while assets remain, for example when retirement accounts are still inaccessible.

exhausted.title: Portfolio exhausted
exhausted.definition: A simulation's assets were depleted when a required payment could not be made.
exhausted.meaning: This is one kind of funding shortfall; the two probabilities should not be added together.

ordinary_income.title: Ordinary income
ordinary_income.definition: Income generally taxed under ordinary-income rates, such as salary or taxable value at vesting.
ordinary_income.meaning: It is different from a capital gain on a later share sale.
